data.title: Oasiz
data.about:
Oasiz by Danube Properties offers a selection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments in the vibrant community of Dubai Silicon Oasis, combining modern design with luxurious living spaces for every lifestyle.

Danube Oasiz at Dubai Silicon Oasis offers more than just luxurious interiors; it presents a lifestyle enriched with top-tier amenities designed to enhance everyday living. Beyond the elegant homes, residents enjoy private pools, fully-equipped gym facilities, and unique spaces such as a floating cinema and a business center.

The development caters to every need, whether you're seeking relaxation at the spa, unwinding in the cabana seating areas, or staying active at the sports courts. With a wide range of recreational and lifestyle-enhancing features, Oasiz provides a balanced and fulfilling living experience for all.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Ultimate Comfort at Oasiz by Danube
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Affordable Luxury: Offering fully furnished apartments with private pools, blending high-end design with affordability.
  • Prime Location: Strategically located in Dubai Silicon Oasis, ensuring seamless connectivity to major highways and key areas like Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, and Dubai International Airport.
  • 1% Payment Plan: Flexible and favorable payment terms with just 1% installments, making it a highly accessible investment option.
  • High Potential for Capital Growth: Located in a thriving tech-centric community, Oasiz by Danube promises strong potential for capital appreciation and long-term investment returns.
  • World-Class Amenities: Residents enjoy exclusive access to a wide array of amenities, including private pools, a gym, a rooftop cinema, a spa, sports courts, and more.

location_tile.title: Prime Location in Dubai Silicon Oasis
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Oasiz by Danube is strategically located in Dubai Silicon Oasis, offering seamless connectivity to key areas of the city. Positioned within a gated community, the development is easily accessible via major highways, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road. This prime location allows for convenient travel to popular destinations such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, and Dubai International Airport.

Additionally, the property is in close proximity to leading tech industries and renowned educational institutions, making it an ideal choice for both professionals and families seeking a central and connected lifestyle.

  • Central Park - 1 Minute
  • Silicon Central Mall - 2 Minutes
  • Al Ain Dubai - 2 Minutes
  • Proposed Metro Station - 3 Minutes
  • Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road - 3 Minutes
  • DSO Lake - 5 Minutes
